note: Kailash Parivar (STORY.md section 9): warm Kailash family slice-of-life Shorts in a REALISTIC-CINEMATIC divine style (not cartoon). Each character has ONE canonical master portrait (<id>.png, 576x1024, FLUX.1-schnell on Kaggle, picked by a person from seeds) and ONE base clip (clips/<id>.mp4, front view, mouth closed) that every episode's close-ups and lip-sync reuse; character-sheet.png = the master sheet that the consistency check compares against. Never regenerate a portrait that exists. ORIGINAL faces only: the style and `negative` keep every face a generic, idealised devotional-painting face that resembles no real person, TV-serial actor or celebrity (the reference channel's Mahadev looks like a TV actor: we never do that). `negative` is used as a true-CFG negative prompt (flux.true_cfg > 1, animate/kaggle/flux_frames.py). Faces: realistic, so the MuseTalk face box is found automatically (OpenCV); `lipsync: false` = no human mouth (elephant head, bull, mouse): those talk with a Wan `talk` clip. Clean-shaven by design: MuseTalk smears beards (lip-sync reject gate). `mouth` = a lips-only blend ellipse inside the automatic face box [cx, cy, rx, ry] (the default lower-face ellipse left a visible seam and a lighter skin patch on these realistic faces: mouth check 0.40, rejected; pilot 15 Nov 2026). `signature` = hue ranges (degrees) + min share of the frame that a scene showing this character must contain (consistency check, characters/kailash/kailash.py qa). Voices: edge-tts hi-IN Madhur/Swara variants of characters/cast/cast.json, fixed per character; never a cloned or famous voice.
style: cinematic realistic devotional film still, painterly photorealism like a high-end mythological film concept painting, divine warm golden rim light and a soft glow, snowy Mount Kailash peaks and pine trees in the background, rich warm colours, gentle atmosphere, highly detailed, sharp focus, original character design with an idealised original face that is not a likeness of any real person, actor or celebrity, no text, no letters, no watermark
portrait: vertical portrait, head and shoulders, the face large and centred in the upper half of the frame, front view looking at the camera, eyes open, mouth gently closed, calm gentle expression, softly blurred background of {bg}
negative: TV serial actor, famous actor, celebrity, likeness of a real person, photograph of an actor in costume, beard, moustache, stubble, cartoon, anime, 3D render, plastic doll skin, extra arms, extra fingers, deformed hands, blurry, low quality, text, letters, words, signature, watermark, logo

mahadev.name: Mahadev
mahadev.description: Mahadev (Lord Shiva) as a serene, compassionate youthful divine man with a calm gentle half-smile, a smooth clean-shaven face with no beard and no moustache, pale ash-blue-grey skin softly dusted with sacred ash, a deeper blue throat, long dark matted jata hair piled in a tall bun with a small silver crescent moon and a thin clear stream of the river Ganga flowing from it, a closed vertical third eye and three horizontal white ash lines on the forehead, rudraksha bead necklaces, a calm cobra coiled around the neck, a tiger-skin cloth over one shoulder
mahadev.wide: Mahadev (serene youthful Lord Shiva, clean-shaven, pale ash-blue-grey skin, deeper blue throat, tall dark jata bun with a silver crescent moon and a thin stream of the Ganga, tripundra ash lines, rudraksha necklaces, a calm cobra around the neck, tiger-skin cloth, a trishul with a small damru beside him)
mahadev.bg: snowy Kailash peaks under a soft blue dawn sky

parvati.name: Mata Parvati
parvati.description: Mata Parvati as a graceful, loving, motherly goddess with a gentle warm smile and kind large eyes, warm golden-wheatish skin, a red bindi and sindoor, long black hair under a delicate golden crown, gold earrings, a small nose ring and a gold necklace, a deep red silk saree with a golden border
parvati.wide: Mata Parvati (graceful motherly goddess, warm golden-wheatish skin, red bindi and sindoor, delicate golden crown, gold jewellery, deep red silk saree with a golden border)
parvati.bg: warm golden light inside a simple stone cave home on Kailash with oil lamps

ganesh.name: Ganesh ji
ganesh.description: Bal Ganesh, a sweet divine little boy of about six with a small gentle elephant head, soft pink-cream skin, big kind sparkling eyes, a short trunk curled up to one side so his small smiling mouth is visible, one small white tusk and one broken tusk, a small golden crown with red gems, a red tilak, a yellow silk dhoti and a red sash, gold armlets
ganesh.wide: Bal Ganesh (sweet divine six-year-old boy with a small gentle elephant head, soft pink-cream skin, one broken tusk, small golden crown, red tilak, yellow silk dhoti, red sash, often holding a round laddoo)
ganesh.talk: Bal Ganesh happily talks to the camera: the corners of his small smiling mouth under the curled trunk open and close as he speaks, the trunk bobs gently with the words, he blinks and his ears move softly.

kartikeya.name: Kartikeya ji
kartikeya.description: Kartikeya ji as a bright, brave, kind divine teenage prince of about fourteen with a smooth clean-shaven boyish face and no beard, warm golden-brown skin, big confident kind eyes, a small golden crown with one peacock feather, gold earrings, a saffron and red silk dhoti with a golden sash, a golden vel spear resting on his shoulder
kartikeya.wide: Kartikeya ji (brave kind divine teenage prince, clean-shaven boyish face, warm golden-brown skin, small golden crown with one peacock feather, saffron and red silk dhoti, golden vel spear, his peacock beside him)
kartikeya.bg: snowy Kailash peaks in warm morning sunlight

nandi.name: Nandi
nandi.description: Nandi, the gentle loyal sacred white bull of Kailash, a calm noble face with big soft kind dark eyes, a smooth white coat, a small hump, short curved horns with golden caps, a red and gold cloth on his back, a string of small brass bells and marigold flowers around his neck
nandi.wide: Nandi (gentle loyal sacred white bull, big kind dark eyes, golden-capped horns, red and gold cloth on his back, brass bells and marigolds around his neck)
nandi.bg: snowy Kailash peaks in soft light
nandi.talk: Nandi gently speaks to the camera: his soft mouth and lips move a little with the words, he blinks slowly and nods very slightly, the small bells on his neck sway.

mushak.name: Mushak
mushak.description: Mushak, a small cute realistic grey-brown field mouse (a real little mouse animal, not an elephant), round bright black eyes, a pink nose, soft fur, big round pink ears, long whiskers, a tiny red and gold cloth with a small golden bell on its back, sitting up on its hind legs on a snowy rock
mushak.wide: Mushak (a small cute realistic grey-brown mouse with round pink ears, long whiskers and a tiny red cloth with a golden bell)
mushak.talk: the little mouse talks excitedly to the camera: his tiny mouth opens and closes, his whiskers twitch and his round ears move.

narad.name: Narad ji
narad.description: Devarshi Narad ji as a cheerful, wise young divine sage of about twenty with a completely smooth hairless boyish face (no beard, no moustache, no stubble), a gentle closed-mouth smile, fair golden skin, hair tied in a top-knot (shikha) with a small white flower, a sandalwood tilak, tulsi bead necklaces, a pale saffron dhoti and a white upper cloth, a wooden veena (mahati) on his shoulder
narad.wide: Narad ji (cheerful young divine sage with a smooth beardless boyish face, hair in a top-knot with a white flower, sandalwood tilak, tulsi beads, pale saffron dhoti, a wooden veena on his shoulder)
narad.bg: glowing clouds above the snowy Kailash peaks
